threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still don’t know the ‘shortcut’ through the market that actually adds 10 minutes to your journey. The locals glide right by it.
Caught the N35 last night and a bloke was serenading the driver with opera. Turned the whole bus into a mini concert—very Brixton.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was living in Neukölln when I saw a group of kids doing a dance-off in the street while the bus driver honked, totally unfazed.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin does a bus strike turn into a spontaneous street party—everyone embracing the chaos with drinks in hand on the sidewalks.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s truly from the Mission if they can name three taco spots that survived the last rent hike. No tourist would bother.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Just saw a guy pull out a saxophone on the 19 Polk and start a mini concert. Everyone just vibed. Classic San Francisco moment.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all bars serve vermut on tap like it's the norm, but most locals prefer it bottled and only during proper hours.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they flinch at the noise of the castellers—locals just cheer them on without a second thought.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think 'pavement' means walking, not a death trap with cyclists zooming by. Welcome to Hackney!
Last night on the 35, a guy argued with the driver about the time. When the driver said 'When I'm late, I'm late,' the whole bus erupted in laughter.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was home when I saw a guy juggling flaming torches while waiting for the bus at Karl-Marx-Strasse. Only in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only here do people argue passionately over the best currywurst while standing in line for a club that hasn't even opened yet.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s a local when they can name three taquerias and then argue over which one has the best salsa. The passion is real.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni at Civic Center today, and a dog hopped off the tracks just in time. Everyone paused, then erupted in laughter. Just another day in SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just about Gaudí, but it's the dimly lit bars and late-night xurros that pulse with real local life.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can spot them easily; they're the ones taking photos of everything on Carrer Verdi while walking into oncoming traffic.
